// Array length preservation: copy operations don't resize slices
lookAhead, err := state.ProposerLookahead()
lastEpochStart := len(lookAhead) - int(params.BeaconConfig().SlotsPerEpoch)
copy(lookAhead[:lastEpochStart], lookAhead[params.BeaconConfig().SlotsPerEpoch:])  // no resize
copy(lookAhead[lastEpochStart:], lastEpochProposers)  // no resize
return state.SetProposerLookahead(lookAhead)  // same slice, same length
